_about: All rules and limits. SI units: meters, seconds, m/s. Read by both the planner (flying_objects, controls, system) and the checker. Groups are for readability only: names are unique across groups and available as rules_v1.<NAME>.

norms._why: Safety norms: these are what the checker verifies
norms._notes: 5 NM / 1000 ft is the ICAO separation standard; adjacent flight levels are exactly 300 m apart, so a 1 m tolerance absorbs rounding. The target zone is a column over the full sector height; with a 10 km radius F020 would start inside the zone (6.8 km away).

potential._why: Shape of the danger potential: norm zone x margin

aircraft._why: Default flight envelope for PlaneConfig (can be overridden per aircraft in config_dict)

controls._why: SearchControls: candidate maneuvers and cost weights
